scope: Ordinary std.ui_layout/std.ui_raster/std.ui_input library behavior; transactional mutation and actual allocation-failure cleanup.

identity.recipe: Sort exact Git paths under crates/lib plus root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock; retain root Cargo files, */Cargo.toml, */build.rs, /src/ paths and lib/ paths; SHA256 of path + NUL + lowercase file SHA256 + newline. Independently recomputed from80bec.

source_review: Layout validates bounded signed positions/nonnegative extents, tracks, gap, output length and available space before writes. Water-level growth uses guarded subtraction and i64 intermediates; stable remainder distribution keeps total placement within bounds.

Raster buffer admission checks stride/row/span by division before offset multiplication. Clipping makes every written offset lie inside the validated surface. All affected premultiplied destination pixels are checked before blending; padding remains untouched. Channel arithmetic stays within i32/u8 bounds for valid premultiplied inputs.

Input uses ordinary nested String ownership. begin validates scalar range before clearing preedit; update validates the complete UTF8 input and cursor before transactional String replacement; commit checks active/revision then mutates the document before clearing the session. Allocation failure therefore preserves existing bytes and session fields.
Library loader adds only embedded ordinary source modules. These APIs introduce no privileged UI/compiler permission proof.
observed_controls: Fixed/flexible row and column layout, clipped intersection and containment, odd spare distribution at maximum bounded extent, invalid track/geometry/gap/output no-mutation controls.

RGBA clipping, premultiplied source-over arithmetic, row padding preservation, undersized buffer/stride/invalid source color rejection, late malformed destination rejection before any pixel change and empty clip success.
Multibyte preedit/cursor, invalid UTF8 and capacity failure, stale revision, successful commit, cancel and inactive status.
Real allocator failure during update and commit preserves preedit bytes/cursor/document/active state; two initialization-failure positions release all earlier owners.

failure_probe_detail.fail_at0: Two explicitly armed failed reallocations, exit0, failures2/live0, preserved actual preedit/document byte checks.
failure_probe_detail.fail_at1: First initialization allocation fails, exit1, failures1/live0.
failure_probe_detail.fail_at2: Second initialization allocation fails, exit1, failures1/live0.

limitations: No independent full58 cross target, full16 impl236 or Clippy replay.
Revision advancement is an explicit caller contract; no platform document mutation service was tested.
No OS window/event/IME service, font shaping, GPU presentation, native Windows, same-semantics Rust cost comparison or terminal/product completion claim.
